stance: Labour market is low-hire, low-fire in the US: initial claims 194k, 4-week average 196.75k, continuing claims 1.701M (down from 1.728M two weeks ago, well below 1.8M). No turn: that needs rising claims, falling JOLTS openings and soft payrolls, and only claims is logged, not rising. UK: unemployment fell to 4.7% from 4.9%, regular pay 3.7%, vacancies at a 5-year low of 691k, so demand is cooling without slack building. UK payrolled change unconfirmed. Would change on US 4-week claims above 215k or continuing claims above 1.8M.
